title: IMUMIA2026: Multi-paradigm motor-imagery EEG dataset (IMU-MI_A)
description: A multi-paradigm motor-imagery EEG dataset recorded with a 64-channel Neuroscan system at 1000 Hz from five healthy participants. This public sample comes from a larger 244-participant collection. Participants performed five body-part motor-imagery tasks (hand, foot, thumb, index finger, index-thumb pinch) with left/right laterality, each under a Classic Arrow paradigm and a Cue-Execution dual-stage paradigm. The data support research on fine motor imagery and brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps amplifier and a 64-channel Quik-Cap (Ag/AgCl passive electrodes, Cz reference, forehead ground, impedance below 10 kOhm) at 1000 Hz. EOG, ECG and EMG channels were also recorded. Each participant completed one session of five runs, one motor-imagery task per run, using visually cued arrow trials with 4 s imagery periods.
